svg.text: The money engine, the officer's day, and the journey the team actually runs
Thirty-two modules — every domain file in backend/app. The rules live here in the open, including the five that are not decided yet, which the register names rather than guessing.
Flat rate: interest on the full loan for the full term
Days past due — null before collection begins, and null is not 0
Bucket + band_set_code; the pair identifies a band, the code alone does not
Accrual net of frozen and reset days; nothing inside the 14-day grace
Oldest due instalment first — the order within one is OD-02, still open
A TABLE, not logic: every screen and job reads pause behaviour here
The arrears block, in the fixed order the tests enforce
total and outstanding are generated — neither can drift
The daily slot: one logged contact per customer per day
One case per customer: two statuses, one mandatory next action
Seven tiers in sequence; every item names the tier that won
The deck's rungs — contractual acts moved by humans, not automation
Saved review criteria; refuses an implicit whole-book default
Who signs a governed act, and under which role
The migrated book: 198 customers with contracts
Order intake and the loan book
The executive overview: progress against targets, and what to do next
AR pipeline, PTP, restructure, review, NPL, service, inter-company
The five gates that stand before an installation
23 intents; one record per document Debt originates
EPC / SPV routed on company_id — one field, not a set of conditions
The run report, the reconciliation, and the gap list
The officer's upload: parsed and staged, never installed
Six governed lists; a value is deactivated, never deleted
The weekly report in Jo's shape, and the two indicators
The round's task script — tasks, not a tour, so the findings are real
the parts that keep the rest honest
The register of what is NOT decided. Every
pending value carries the decision that
gates it and the owner who must close it.
One clock. Business date plus the machine's
own time-of-day once wrote stamps nobody
could defend; now there is one source.
RFC 9457 problem details. `code` is the only
field a client branches on, so it is the one
field that may never be improvised.
Who took the book out, and why. The
governed POST — and the ungrouped GET
that used to answer 200 to anyone, closed.
the output of a UAT round, not a tester's
private state to be isolated away.
• Money is Decimal end to end (ADR-006 §Decision 2). A float anywhere in this layer is a defect, not a rounding difference.
• The ladder and the aging band sets are different instruments. The system computes an INDICATIVE rung only, and ladder_mode can suppress even that.
• A figure nobody has agreed to bill is badged indicative wherever it appears — the badge is part of the number, not decoration around it.
• Nothing anywhere derives pause behaviour. fee_states.py is a table; a second implementation of it would be the bug, however correct it looked.
